notes: Independently read all 23 eligible production TS modules in full, plus package.json and openclaw.plugin.json. The 49 plugin files partition into 25 reviewed and 24 excluded records. Source production files match the pinned commit; source AGENTS/skill documentation edits are outside this production audit.

All plugin-local imports and reexports resolve inside extensions/openrouter. No additional plugin-owned/shared shipped source lies outside this root. node:path is a Node built-in. Public SDK facade exports and package export keys were checked to establish provenance without adding SDK implementation dependencies.

provider-contract-api.ts is shipped production source: src/plugins/provider-contract-public-artifacts.ts loads provider-contract-api.js through its generic artifact candidate. provider-policy-api.ts is likewise loaded through PROVIDER_POLICY_ARTIFACT in src/plugins/provider-policy-surface.ts. They are included despite sparse direct local runtime imports. capability-catalog.ts is the manifest-declared capabilityCatalogEntry.

api.ts reexports plugin-owned provider factories and onboarding bindings. applyOpenrouterConfig/applyOpenrouterProviderConfig are fields returned by createAliasOnlyPresetAppliers, not unchanged imported SDK exports; their local import/reexport sites add no synthetic SDK provenance. provider-defaults.ts contains only a plugin-owned URL constant.

Only the six explicit calls in index.ts register(api) contribute api-member findings. defineSingleProviderPluginEntry may register the model provider internally; those SDK-helper internals are not plugin source calls and do not imply api.registerProvider.

ProviderAuthContext.runtime is RuntimeEnv (src/plugins/provider-authentication.types.ts:62), not PluginRuntime. OAuth ctx.runtime.log, ctx.prompter, ctx.oauth and provider catalog/usage contexts therefore do not produce public API/runtime paths. The stream logger returned by createSubsystemLogger is likewise not a PluginRuntime handle.

Provider-family hooks and HTTP/OAuth helper result objects are SDK return values, not OpenClawPluginApi/PluginRuntime. Their member calls/selections and local wrapper calls do not add transitive SDK-export or API/runtime references. No runtime-member or named API hook registrations occur.

Explicit typeof references to resolveApiKeyForProvider, startProviderOAuthLoopbackCallbackServer, resolveProviderHttpRequestConfig, sanitizeConfiguredModelProviderRequest, fetchWithTimeoutGuarded and fetchWithSsrFGuard make those SDK-export records mixed. They do not change their SDK modules to mixed absent actual type-import sites. Imported types have type-reference evidence as well as type-import.

asOptionalRecord is locally imported as readRecord in index.ts and tool-schemas.ts; findings retain the original public export. DEFAULT_CONTEXT_TOKENS is a value import used as a scalar, with import only. Bare value passing is not an invented member-access.

Manifest contracts are the top-level providers entry and six contracts categories. Setup/providerAuthChoices/modelCatalog/providerRequest/provider metadata, categories and config schema are descriptive/configuration metadata under the frozen benchmark and create no additional contract identities.

All 20 .test. modules are excluded by basename after verifying the full eligible source imports do not reference tests; there are no ambiguous test-only helper exclusions, build outputs or declaration files. This is source-phase coverage, not a published-artifact inventory.
